question: HA#569: PL-11 reads the spec repo's marker vocabulary (OQ-/AS- markers named in code spans on two pages) as 5 malformed open questions. How do those rows clear?

options.label: Fenced definition block ⭐ (Recommended)
options.consequence: Canon writes the marker vocabulary inside a fenced block, which HR-13 already exempts; no lint rule changes, the 5 rows leave the baseline. Recorded as an HR row.

options.label: Lint exempts code spans
options.consequence: PL-11 learns that a marker named inside a code span is not a question; a lint-rule change (and possibly a nen change), applying everywhere.
